data.name: Bujaybah
data.long_meaning: The name Bujaybah is derived from the Arabic word 'Bujthah' which means patience, endurance, steadfastness. This name is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a noblewoman who was known for her unwavering patience and steadfastness during times of hardship and trial.
